eve (arch): quick note: bursty alias flips in staging caused mass cold starts. want to add rollout metadata to soften evicts.
dan (runtime): current flow: alias write -> immediate unbind -> KV rebuilds. brutal for latency.
li (infra): what fields are you thinking?
eve (arch): minimal: stability_window_ms, evict_grace_ms, alias_mode=(hard|soft|sticky), expected_dual_serve, tenant_opt_out. example: stability=600k, evict_grace=180k, alias_mode=soft.
dan (runtime): runtime plan: lease states ACTIVE -> PENDING_DEFERRED_EVICT -> STALE. on flip mark previous pending and background reconcile after grace and low traffic. tenant pins always override.
pam (product): UX: need console flag for expected_dual_serve and docs note. customers must opt into staged dual-serving.
sal (sre): telemetry: alias_transition_count, deferred_eviction_seconds, dual_serve_ratio, pin_override_count. alert if deferred_eviction > SLA and error rate rises.
infra-bot: created INF-2026-9001: "alias soft-evict metrics & migration" assigned to dan.
eve (arch): decision: prototype soft alias_mode in staging behind FF. owners: dan(runtime), li(infra), pam(product), sal(sre). follow-up: RFC + console copy.
